title: The Most Entitled Shoplifting Woman Ever
description:
On June 21st, 2023, officers responded to a case of shoplifting. The store manager reported that a female had left the store without paying for the merchandise. The officers had to resort to brute force because the female was not willing to comply with them. The female was charged with petit theft, battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
